title: Packages
description: Track parcels from any carrier in Hyper+Space and on its page: type a tracking number and TrackingMore finds the carrier, then each parcel shows its status, its last event and how long ago; open one for every event. Delivered parcels move to Delivered and are not asked again. Uses your own TrackingMore API key: each new parcel takes one of your plan's credits, refreshing takes none.
examples: Hyper+Space › Packages, type 1Z999AA10123456784 shoes and press Return: tracked as shoes, its carrier found, under On the way
Type track LX123456789CN in Hyper+Space and press Return: Packages starts tracking it in one step

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: TrackingMore API key
preferences.description: Your own key, kept in the Keychain: make an account at trackingmore.com, open Developer › API Key and click Generate API key. Each new parcel uses one credit of your TrackingMore plan; refreshing a parcel uses none.
